title: Choose the site's structure
question: The Equal brand is fixed. Pick how the design-system website is organised. You can steer or re-roll.

options.label: The App Map
options.lineage: Screen flow maps designers pin on the wall
options.thesis: You find a component by finding it in the real app.
options.viewport: A wide canvas of the real, live Equal AI screens (Chats, Chat, You, the flows) side by side. Hovering any part outlines it and names its component; clicking opens that component's page. The theme switch flips every phone at once.
options.risk: Tokens and icons have no screen to live on, so the foundations need a conventional index next to the map.

options.label: The Command Index
options.lineage: Command palettes and dense spec indexes
options.thesis: Everything is one keystroke away, and every page answers first.
options.viewport: A big search field above a dense, sortable index of every token, type style, icon, component and screen. Each result copies its CSS / TS / Kotlin name in one click; pages open as compact spec sheets with the live component on top.
options.risk: Very efficient, but the brand and the app's warmth show less until you open a page.

options.label: The Reference Manual
options.thesis: A calm, deep reference you can read top to bottom or jump into anywhere.
options.viewport: Left sidebar of every section, a reading column that starts with a live example in light and dark, and a right-hand list of contents. The home page opens with the Equal lockup and a live Chats screen.
options.risk: The most familiar arrangement; it only stands out through the quality of its examples.
